name: GP0
description: General-purpose input/output 0: your program can read or control a digital signal. One alternate function is I2C0 SDA (data); software must select that function. In Python, Pin(0) names this GPIO; its physical header position is 1.
oled_description: General-purpose input/output 0: your program can read or control a digital signal. One alternate function is I2C0 SDA (data); software must select that function. In our OLED wiring, GP0 carries SDA. In Python, Pin(0) names this GPIO; its physical header position is 1.

name: GP1
description: General-purpose input/output 1: your program can read or control a digital signal. One alternate function is I2C0 SCL (clock); software must select that function. In Python, Pin(1) names this GPIO; its physical header position is 2.
oled_description: General-purpose input/output 1: your program can read or control a digital signal. One alternate function is I2C0 SCL (clock); software must select that function. In our OLED wiring, GP1 carries SCL. In Python, Pin(1) names this GPIO; its physical header position is 2.

name: GND
description: Ground is the shared electrical reference. All GND pins are connected on the Pico.
oled_description: Ground is the shared electrical reference. All GND pins are connected on the Pico. Connect the OLED GND lead to any one of them.

name: RUN
description: Reset control. Pulling RUN low resets the RP2040. Leave it unconnected for ordinary projects; it is not an ordinary GPIO pin.
oled_description: Reset control. Pulling RUN low resets the RP2040. Leave it unconnected for this project; it is not an ordinary GPIO pin.

name: GP26
description: General-purpose input/output 26: your program can read or control a digital signal. One alternate function is I2C1 SDA (data); software must select that function. It can also measure an analogue voltage using ADC0.
oled_description: General-purpose input/output 26: your program can read or control a digital signal. One alternate function is I2C1 SDA (data); software must select that function. It can also measure an analogue voltage using ADC0. We leave it free for later projects.

name: GP27
description: General-purpose input/output 27: your program can read or control a digital signal. One alternate function is I2C1 SCL (clock); software must select that function. It can also measure an analogue voltage using ADC1.
oled_description: General-purpose input/output 27: your program can read or control a digital signal. One alternate function is I2C1 SCL (clock); software must select that function. It can also measure an analogue voltage using ADC1. We leave it free for later projects.

name: AGND
description: Analogue ground, intended as a quiet reference for analogue measurements. It is connected to ground on the board.
oled_description: Analogue ground, intended as a quiet reference for analogue measurements. It is connected to ground on the board; our OLED can use an ordinary GND pin.

name: GP28
description: General-purpose input/output 28: your program can read or control a digital signal. One alternate function is I2C0 SDA (data); software must select that function. It can also measure an analogue voltage using ADC2.
oled_description: General-purpose input/output 28: your program can read or control a digital signal. One alternate function is I2C0 SDA (data); software must select that function. It can also measure an analogue voltage using ADC2. We leave it free for later projects.

name: ADC_VREF
description: Reference voltage for analogue-to-digital measurements. Leave this connected as supplied on the board; it is not a general-purpose power output.
oled_description: Reference voltage for analogue-to-digital measurements. Leave this connected as supplied on the board; it is not our OLED power connection.

name: 3V3(OUT)
description: Regulated 3.3 V output from the Pico. This can power small external circuits that use 3.3 V. This is physical pin 36, not GP36.
oled_description: Regulated 3.3 V output from the Pico. Connect this to the OLED VCC lead. This is physical pin 36, not GP36.

name: 3V3_EN
description: Enable control for the 3.3 V regulator. Pulling this low turns the regulator off. This is not the 3.3 V output; leave it unconnected for ordinary projects.
oled_description: Enable control for the 3.3 V regulator. Pulling this low turns the regulator off. This is not the 3.3 V output; leave it alone here.

name: GND
description: Ground is the shared electrical reference. All GND pins are connected on the Pico.
oled_description: Ground is the shared electrical reference. All GND pins are connected on the Pico. Connect the OLED GND lead to any one of them.

name: VSYS
description: Main system power input. Its job is supplying the board, rather than acting as a GPIO. It supplies the board's regulator and is not an ordinary GPIO pin.
oled_description: Main system power input. Its job is supplying the board, rather than acting as a GPIO. Use 3V3(OUT) for the OLED in this project.

name: VBUS
description: USB supply voltage, normally about 5 V when USB is connected. It has a different voltage and purpose from 3V3(OUT).
oled_description: USB supply voltage, normally about 5 V when USB is connected. Do not substitute this for the 3.3 V OLED connection in our wiring.
